char *  fn
) 
 

cache_load - load a file containing the cache for a folder do not call model_evt() from within; we're called by the scanner rather than the GUI thread!

Parameters:
q - the directory the contents of which are to be loaded
fn - the path and name of the file to load

cache_el* cache_load_el (  int  fd,
ulong *  len
) 
 

cache_load_el - load a single cache-element from a cache-file.

Returns:
the address of the new cache-element's header (which must be freed). the data begin directly after the returned header (and will be free()d along with the header).
Parameters:
fd - the file-descriptor for the cache-file to save in
len - where (if non-NULL) the number of data-bytes read will be stored, excluding the length of the header

ulong  len,

cache_save_el - save a single entry in cache.

Returns:

Parameters:

tag - tag describing the type of the entry
len - the size of the entry (excluding its header)
